title: Can You Trust Your Trust Measure?
reasoning: The paper's core investigation involves evaluating how trust questionnaires, which include explicit ethical dimensions, apply to human-robot interactions. It specifically analyzes the 'sincere & ethical' factor of the Multidimensional Measure of Trust (MDMT), which includes items like 'principled,' 'honest,' 'truthful,' and 'benevolent.' The studies explore whether participants consider these moral and ethical concepts applicable to robots, which is a central part of the paper's contribution, not a peripheral discussion.
